name: ModelVariant802_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant802_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a slot glides over and back while a cloud of particles rises around the opposing slot and the slot scale swells and shrinks); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, sets the glide velocity, seeds the particles and packs one texture image, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 while the particles grow, 1 once after that, 2 after the glide back and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; only the USA and Japanese discs build this header. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
